plan_path_or_content:
## Coherent Actions

| Action | Addresses Gap | What it does | Model | Reason |
|--------|---------------|--------------|-------|--------|
| A1 | G1 | Implement `_factcheck_engine.py` from scratch — `factcheck_run()` entrypoint, round loop, `_dispatch_checkers()` (parallel Agent calls), `_aggregate_round()` (DIRTY/PASS/ESCALATE verdict), `_write_round_marker()` (schema_version:2 YAML frontmatter), `FACTCHECK_MAX_ROUNDS` constant (default 2) | Opus | New system with multiple interacting components; requires judgment on round-loop termination, checker-spawn isolation contract, marker schema design. |
| A2 | G2 | Implement `_factcheck_engine.py` checker-model provenance — `_read_checker_transcript()` (reads subagent JSONL from `~/.claude/projects/<sessionId>/subagents/agent-<agentId>.jsonl`), `_normalize_model_family()` (maps raw model IDs to family slugs), `_verify_checker_models()` (hard-fail on non-Sonnet or mixed-family runs), write `checker_models_raw` + `provenance: code-verified` to marker | Opus | Requires deep judgment: JSONL transcript structure, model-family normalization table, when to hard-fail vs. warn, backward-compat for pre-provenance markers. |
| A3 | G3 | Implement `check-extraction-gate.sh` — parse `R<N>.md` frontmatter, extract `verdict:` field (schema_version:2), block extraction pipeline on `verdict: DIRTY` or `verdict: ESCALATE`, emit actionable error message | Sonnet | Shell script with deterministic YAML parse; no judgment. |
| A4 | G4 | Implement `check-extraction-gate.sh` IS_PASS2 branch — read `_coverage-check-<book_slug>.marker`, verify `verdict: PASS` in frontmatter, block Pass 2 if missing or non-PASS | Sonnet | Deterministic extension of A3; same pattern. |
| A5 | G5 | Implement `_write_coverage_check_marker()` in `_factcheck_engine.py` — writes `_coverage-check-{book_slug}.marker` with schema_version:2 frontmatter after 3-Sonnet coverage-check convergence | Sonnet | Mechanical marker-write; mirrors `_write_round_marker()` from A1. |
| A6 | G6 | Update `factcheck-research-file.sh` dispatcher and `check-research-gate.sh` reader — retarget from legacy R<N>.md grep-based parsing to `verdict:` frontmatter field (schema_version:2) | Sonnet | Mechanical retargeting once A1 marker format is locked. |
| A7 | G7 | Update `check-plan-gates.sh` Gate 3 — retarget from legacy prose-body convergence evidence to `verdict:` frontmatter field (schema_version:2) | Sonnet | Same mechanical retargeting as A6. |
| A8 | G8 | Add migration compatibility — `_read_verdict()` helper that accepts both pre-v2 (grep-based legacy) and schema_version:2 (frontmatter) formats; emit deprecation warning on legacy format | Sonnet | Backward-compat wrapper; deterministic format detection. |
| A9 | G9 | Write `tests/test_factcheck_engine.py` — unit tests for `factcheck_run()` PASS/DIRTY/ESCALATE paths, `_normalize_model_family()` table, `_verify_checker_models()` hard-fail cases, `_write_round_marker()` YAML output | Sonnet | Mechanical test authoring once A1-A2 are locked. |
| A10 | G10 | Write `tests/test_extraction_gate.sh` — bats-based integration tests for `check-extraction-gate.sh` PASS, DIRTY, ESCALATE, and IS_PASS2 branch | Sonnet | Shell test authoring. |
| V  | all | Smoke tests: `python3 -m pytest tests/test_factcheck_engine.py -q` → all PASS; `bats tests/test_extraction_gate.sh` → all PASS; `py_compile` clean on `_factcheck_engine.py`; `git diff --name-only` scope check | Sonnet | Deterministic. |

This plan is dense: A1 + A2 together touch 800+ LOC of new Python with interacting components (round loop + transcript parsing + model-family normalization + marker schema), significant internal state, and multiple judgment calls about failure modes. A1 alone — the full `factcheck_run()` + round loop + marker write — is at the boundary of a focused routine-model session. A2 (checker-model provenance) is a separate judgment-heavy subsystem requiring Opus. A3-A10 are mechanical but numerous. As one un-sliced unit this plan exceeds the routine model's comfortable working capacity.
desired_outcome: The fact-check engine (factcheck_run, round loop, marker schema, provenance verification) ships with all downstream gate scripts retargeted to schema_version:2 frontmatter, so any pipeline that reads R<N>.md or coverage-check markers gets deterministic, machine-parseable verdicts instead of grepping prose.

context_budget_per_agent.routine: ~8000 tokens (comfortable ceiling for routine model — A1+A2 together exceed this)
